title: [Decision] 通知偏好 topic/channel: pickers, refuse unmatched values, or free text as ruled on #25346?
body:
domain:ui#6 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUR8Nu4M7tbtgES7q2

Filing gate: ② a decision only the maintainer can make. Filed by the domain:ui#6 seat from #30208 row 6 and comment 6651344343, which would reverse the route A ruling on #25346.

## 维护者速读

- 事由：通知偏好的「主题」「渠道」仍是手填文本（默认 `*`），填错的值被存下但永远匹配不到任何通知，没有任何提示；#30208 第 6 行与评论 6651344343 要求改成从已知值中选择。
- 已裁：#25346 于 2026-10-23 裁 A（评论 6365616409，原话「A」）：两字段保持文本、不做选择器，只在帮助文字里说明值从哪来；该裁决已由 PR #25449 落地。
- 现状：渠道在运行时可枚举（`getRegisteredChannels()`），但只写进启动日志，没有任何接口把清单交给控制台；主题没有任何登记表，ADR-0030 写的 `defineTopic()` 至今零实现。
- 选项：A 维持原裁；B 保持文本，但写入时拒绝当前没有渠道的值（主题无法校验）；C 文本字段加「建议来源」契约，控制台画成可自填的下拉（渠道清单由服务端提供，主题从平台固定主题起步）；D 渠道改封闭 select、`*` 改拼写、启动时转换存量行（破坏性）。
- 推荐：C——两年后这页应是「已登记主题 × 已登记渠道」的矩阵（Salesforce、ServiceNow 皆如此），C 不翻 A（字段仍是文本，不新增拒绝，`*` 照存），分 spec／services／ui 三车道三卡落地；只看①选 C，②③④不翻转。
- 不在本问：免打扰（quiet_hours）的时间段控件另立卡；本卡只裁主题／渠道的录入方式。

## 背景 (Background)

#30208 is the maintainer's own walkthrough of Setup (「以上都同意，立卡」, 2026-11-05). Its row 6 reads: 通知偏好's Topic and Channel are free text, default `*`, and a wrong value silently matches nothing; 免打扰 is JSON. Comment 6651344343 adds the same ask for 通知模板's new form. The seat shipped rows 4 and 9 in PR #30488 (+135/−36, merged 2026-11-05T13:58Z) and reported row 6 as `carrier: maintainer (needs_decision)` in os-dev-report 6659032953, because the picker would reverse a ruling the maintainer's project already made on #25346. The Release comment 6659910397 re-routed the remaining rows to `domain:server` and named this decision as the seat's to file. ⛔ No lane builds row 6 before the ruling.

One-sentence problem, as the administrator sees it: an administrator who wants to mute one kind of notification has to type its machine name from memory, and if they get one letter wrong the mute is saved, shown in the grid as if it worked, and never fires.

## Governing text

- #25346, Ruling comment 6365616409 (2026-10-23T13:08Z), letter A on os-dev-report 6365345478, verbatim:
  > Ruled-by: Sales (`os-sales`, the owner of the project that runs this lane), in the project chat at 2026-10-23T13:07:33Z, answering the coordinator's A/B/C summary of the report above. Verbatim: 「A」
  >
  > What A means for this card (the report's option A, unchanged):
  > 1. `topic` and `channel` on `sys_notification_preference` stay `text`; no picker, no select, no stored-data change, nothing newly refused.
  > …
  > 5. A real dropdown over open vocabularies (option C, a spec-lane suggestion list on text fields) is not part of this card and is not filed by it.
- The report that ruling answered (6365345478) measured: "Topic: no enumerable set exists … Channel: a runtime set exists (service-messaging registers inbox always, email and sms while their transport is resolvable; nobody registers push), but no declarable field shape offers it as a picker without a contract change: a select option value is a SystemIdentifierSchema (lowercase, 2+ chars), so the stored wildcard '*' cannot be an option; a select is closed on the write path, while the channel seam is open by contract".
- #24770 ruling D (recorded 6293376907, ADR-0030 status line): templates narrowed to the channels that render them; landed as the `channel_renders_template` refusal (PR #25028, +357/−251, 12 files, `fix(service-messaging)!`). It shows the one precedent for a loud refusal on a free-text channel column in this package.
- ADR-0030 (accepted 2026-06-01), § Low-code platform requirements this unlocks: "Declarative topic catalog via `defineTopic()` — app builders register notification types as **metadata**" and "Per-user notification **preferences UI** (user×topic×channel) … become first-class, Studio-configurable objects". `git grep -n "defineTopic" packages` → 0 hits: the catalog was never built.
- ADR-0118 D1 (`notification-preference.object.ts` `user_id` block): "The write door refuses an id no `sys_user` row holds (`reference_not_found`), so `'*'` and a mistyped id are refused instead of being stored to match nobody." The same object already chose loud refusal over silent no-match for its third key.
- grep for a ruling on pickers over text fields: `git grep -n "suggestion" packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` → one comment line on `shared/suggestions.zod` (did-you-mean for metadata keys); none found on suggestion sources for field values.

## Protocol statement

Options A and B change no spec acceptance or declaration surface. Option C adds one declared key family in `packages/spec` (a suggestion source on `text` fields) and one read endpoint; it is a protocol-class change under the grading rules (p1 + in-research major `target:` when ruled). Option D narrows what `sys_notification_preference.channel` accepts and rewrites stored `*` rows: `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, BREAKING, full dogfood. The title of this card carries no `!`; the ruling decides which letter's PR does.

## Premise (re-check before ruling)

Read on `origin/main` at filing. Each line is one command and its reading today:

- `git grep -n "ruling A 2026-10-23" packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/notification-preference.object.ts` → 2 hits (lines 137, 160): both fields cite the ruling and stay `Field.text`, `defaultValue: '*'`.
- `git grep -n "WILDCARD" packages/services/service-messaging/src/preference-resolver.ts | head -3` → `const WILDCARD = '*'`; `resolveRow` tries `(user|topic|channel)` then each wildcard fallback by exact key. A value no event carries and no channel registers is never a key, so it is stored and matches nothing; no log line, no warning, no refusal.
- `git grep -n "getRegisteredChannels" packages ui` → 2 hits: the definition (`messaging-service.ts:562`, "The channel ids that resolve RIGHT NOW") and the boot log line (`messaging-service-plugin.ts:619`). No REST route or `/meta` surface serves it.
- `git grep -n "defineTopic" packages` → 0 hits. Platform topics are fixed strings at each emit site (`approval.*` in plugin-approvals, `collab.mention`, `security.access_upgrade`, `auth.phone_otp`, `auth.phone_invite`); a flow's notify step names any string.
- `git grep -n "channel_renders_template" packages/services/service-messaging/src/objects/notification-template.object.ts` → the `cross_field` rule: a template row naming a channel other than `email`/`sms` is refused with `code: rule_violation`, `field: channel`, and `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx` (the `extractFieldErrors` branch) writes that reason under the drawn input. So for 通知模板 the channel half of comment 6651344343 already refuses loudly on `main`; the topic half is free text with no check, as on 通知偏好. The seat should re-measure the comment's "fails with no message" on the channel input before the ruling is applied to templates; this card does not depend on it.
- `gh api repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/comments/6365616409 --jq .body | head -2` → the ruling above, unchanged.

## The question

For `sys_notification_preference.topic` and `.channel` (and 通知模板's `topic`, whose channel is already refused), should the console:

- keep them as free text with help only (ruling A stands),
- keep free text but refuse or warn when the value matches nothing the deployment knows,
- offer the known values as a picker while still accepting a typed value, or
- make channel a closed select?

The 免打扰 (quiet_hours) time-range control is not part of this question; it follows on its own card whichever letter is ruled.

## Options × real cost × workload

| Option | What is done | What the administrator sees (cost) | Workload: lane · stages/PRs · precedent |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** Keep as ruled | Nothing. Row 6 of #30208 closes with a pointer to ruling 6365616409. | Types machine names from the help text; a typo is saved and mutes nothing, with no sign. The grid shows the broken row as a normal row. | 0 · `domain:ui` one comment · precedent: PR #25449 (+124/−14, 9 files) already landed the help text. |
| **B** Free text, refuse what matches nothing | `service-messaging` adds a write-time check on `channel`: a value that is neither `*` nor in `getRegisteredChannels()` at write time is refused (`VALIDATION_FAILED`, `field: channel`), the console marks the input inline. `topic` cannot be checked (no set exists); its help stays. | A wrong channel is refused with a sentence on the field. A wrong topic still saves silently. New cost: `email` is refused until an email service is configured, so a preference cannot be prepared ahead of the transport; a channel a plugin stops registering freezes its stored rows on edit. | S–M · `domain:services` · 1 PR (hook or service-level validator, pins, changeset) · precedent: PR #25028 (+357/−251, 12 files) for a refusal on a channel column; ADR-0118 D1 `reference_not_found` for refuse-over-store on the same object. Note the check must read the live registry, which a declarative `cross_field` rule cannot; it is a write hook. |
| **C** Picker with free entry (suggestion source on text fields) | Three cards under one ④ parent: (1) `domain:spec`: a `text` field may declare a suggestion source (a served list the console reads; values are offered, not enforced; `*` offered as "All"); (2) `domain:services`: a read endpoint that serves `getRegisteredChannels()` plus `*`, and a topic list seeded from the platform's fixed topics plus the distinct `sys_notification.topic` values this organization has stored; (3) `domain:ui`: the generic text renderer draws a combobox when a source is declared, typed values still accepted. Fields stay `text`; nothing newly refused; no stored row touched. | Picks `approval.requested` from a list instead of typing it; picks inbox / email / sms / All. A typed value is still accepted and still silently matches nothing (unchanged from today). | L · 3 lanes · 3 PRs + 1 spec card · no precedent for a suggestion source on field values (`field.zod.ts` carries none); nearest shapes: the flow `{x}` picker over a served scope (ADR-0072, objectui `FlowReferenceField.tsx`) and the `sys_user` lookup picker that replaced free-text user ids on this very object (#24895, closed). |
| **D** Closed select for channel (reverses A) | `channel` becomes `Field.select(['inbox','email','sms', <all>])`; `*` cannot be an option value, so the wildcard is re-spelled and a boot conversion rewrites stored `*` rows; `topic` stays text. The open `registerChannel` seam is closed for preferences: a plugin's channel cannot be chosen. | A three-value dropdown plus All. A typo on channel is impossible; on topic unchanged. A plugin that registers its own channel has no row an administrator can make for it. Every stored row is rewritten once. | M–L · `domain:services` · 1 breaking PR (`!`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, migration, full dogfood) · precedent for the conversion: `convertWildcardPreferenceUsers` (ADR-0118 D1 boot rewrite of `user_id='*'`); precedent for the narrowing: PR #25028. |

Workload gap to name: C is ≥3× B. The ① readings are not close (below), so the gap does not change the letter; it changes the phasing in 裁后执行.

## Business meaning (one line each)

- **A** = the preference page stays a developer's config table: it works for whoever knows the topic names, which today is the person who wrote the flow.
- **B** = the platform refuses a delivery address it cannot deliver to, like a mail client refusing a malformed address, but only for the channel half; the topic half still accepts anything.
- **C** = the page becomes what Salesforce's and ServiceNow's notification preference pages are: a list of notification types × channels the system knows, with the escape hatch of typing one it does not list yet.
- **D** = channel becomes a fixed three-way switch built into the platform; a vendor-added channel is a second-class citizen on this page.

## Four axes, argued from the business side

### ① Long-term platform fit (does this shrink or grow special cases?)

- ADR-0030 already names the end state: a declared topic catalog and a first-class preference matrix. Two years out, an administrator opens 通知偏好 and sees the notification types the installed apps declare, crossed with the channels this deployment can send on, exactly as Salesforce (Notification Builder: custom notification types × channels) and ServiceNow (Notification preferences per notification × device/channel) model it. Free text on this page is the gap, not a design.
- A keeps the gap and keeps the help text as the only bridge. B adds a special case: a refusal whose answer depends on which transports happen to be configured at the moment of writing (write `email` before SMTP exists → refused; configure SMTP → the same write passes). That is a contract that changes with deployment state, the kind of special case the platform has been removing. D closes a seam the ADR deliberately left open (`MessagingChannel` is public; `push` is registered as a provider today) and introduces a second wildcard spelling in one row.
- C builds the catalog the ADR promised, one generic mechanism (a suggestion source on text fields) reusable by every open vocabulary the platform has (flow topic names, template topics, channel ids, later: tags, locales), and leaves the field contract exactly as ruled. ① reads: C > A > B > D.

### ② Real business pull today

- The maintainer hit it on their own walkthrough (#30208 row 6, and again on 通知模板, comment 6651344343); HotCRM's QA pass hit it before (#25346, hotcrm#2194 T2-U15). The same object already replaced its free-text user id with a picker because typing a 32-character id was unworkable (#24895). Two independent reporters, three surfaces, on a page every administrator who tunes notifications opens.
- Zero pull for D's closed set specifically: nobody has asked to forbid plugin channels; the ask is "let me pick". B answers half the ask on half the fields.

### ③ Protection against AI (and human) mistakes: who sees what when it goes wrong

- Today and under A: a wrong value is **silently tolerated**. An agent or an administrator writing `approval.requsted` sees a saved row; the person keeps receiving the notification; nobody is told. This is the "stored to match nobody" shape ADR-0118 D1 removed from `user_id` on this same object.
- B: a wrong channel is **loudly refused** on the field; a wrong topic is still silently tolerated. Half closed.
- C: the enumeration is offered, so the common path never types; a typed value is still silently tolerated, by design, because the topic set is open (a flow may name a topic the catalog has not seen yet). Closed enumeration where one exists (channels), suggestions where the set is open (topics). The silent-miss residue stays for typed-in topics; the card's follow-up can add a warning (not a refusal) when a typed topic matches no stored notification, once the served list exists.
- D: channel fully closed and loud; topic unchanged. ③ reads: D ≈ B > C > A on loudness; C > D on closed-enumeration coverage (it covers topics too).

### ④ Startup-stage non-proliferation (every declared key is a permanent obligation)

- A declares nothing. B declares nothing in spec but adds a runtime refusal rule to maintain against the registry. D declares a select with three option values and a wildcard spelling, plus a migration, forever.
- C declares one key family in spec (the suggestion source). It is one mechanism, not one per field, and ADR-0030 already carries the topic-catalog obligation; C is the delivery of a declared commitment, not a new one. The served channel list is a read of state the service already holds. ④ reads: A > C ≈ B > D; C does not add a gate, so the ④ exception does not apply.

## Recommendation

**C.** By ① alone: the platform's own ADR and the mainstream platforms it models say the preference page is a matrix of known types × known channels, and C is the only option whose end state is that page while keeping the field contract ruling A set (text stays text, `*` stays `*`, nothing newly refused, the channel seam stays open). It does not reverse route A; it files the spec-lane suggestion list that ruling A's item 5 explicitly left for a separate decision.

Self-check: 只看①选 C;②③④ 是否翻转:否(②是 C 的拉动最强;③ C 的静默残留在主题一侧,与 A 同、比 B 和 D 宽,但 B 与 D 只闭合渠道一侧,C 同时覆盖主题;④ C 落的是 ADR-0030 已承诺的目录,不新增门禁)。工作量 C ≥3× B,已点名;它只改分期,不改字母。

Why not the others, one sentence each:
- A: leaves the maintainer-reported symptom in place on the page the maintainer walked; the help text is a bridge, not the page.
- B: makes refusal depend on which transports are configured at write time, and leaves topics (the field people actually mistype) untouched.
- D: trades a three-value dropdown for a breaking migration, a second wildcard spelling, and a closed seam the ADR keeps open; the report on #25346 already measured this and the project ruled against it.

Confidence gaps, stated and not used to change the letter:
- Whether the console's generic form renderer can draw a combobox from a declared source without a product-named widget is `domain:ui`'s measurement in card (3); the nearest existing shape is the flow reference picker (ADR-0072).
- The topic list in C starts as "platform fixed topics + topics this organization has already stored"; a flow's not-yet-sent topic will not be listed until first send. That is the open-vocabulary residue; it is why typed values stay accepted.
- Comment 6651344343's "fails with no message" on 通知模板's channel could not be reproduced from the code (the refusal is attached to `channel` and `form.tsx` marks it inline); only its topic half is established.

## 裁后执行 (After the ruling)

- **A**: the domain:ui#6 seat posts one comment on #30208 closing row 6 and the 6651344343 row with a pointer to 6365616409; no card, no PR. The 免打扰 control is filed on its own.
- **B**: one `domain:server` card for `service-messaging`: a write hook that refuses a `channel` neither `*` nor in `getRegisteredChannels()` (message names the ids resolvable now and `*`), pins, `patch` changeset, `Clause-②: no`; the console needs no change (the inline marking exists). Topic help unchanged. The seat files it from this ruling; `domain:services` builds it.
- **C** (recommended): one ④ parent card and three children, filed by the domain:ui#6 seat from this ruling in this order, each gated on the previous:
  1. `domain:spec`: suggestion source on `text` fields (shape, declaration surface, what the console may and may not enforce: offered, never refused; `*` listed with a label). Protocol-class: p1, in-research major `target:`.
  2. `domain:services`: a read endpoint serving channels (`getRegisteredChannels()` + `*`) and topics (platform fixed list + distinct stored `sys_notification.topic` for the organization); `sys_notification_preference.topic/channel` and `sys_notification_template.topic` declare the source. Help text stays as ruled on #25346.
  3. `domain:ui`: the generic text renderer draws a combobox when a source is declared, typed values accepted; first-release card of the consumer major per the grading rules. Row 6 of #30208 closes when (3) lands.
  Until (1) lands, no lane touches these fields; this card's ruling is the only authority (3) cites.
- **D**: one `domain:services` breaking card (`!`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, migration entry, full dogfood), with the wildcard spelling and the plugin-channel answer decided in that card's claim before code.
- In every letter: the 免打扰 (quiet_hours) time-range control is a separate `domain:ui` card over an existing `Field.json` shape and does not wait on this ruling.

## Business reason, reader, dedupe

- **Business reason:** an administrator tuning notifications (the maintainer on their own walkthrough; HotCRM's QA pass before) must type machine names; a wrong one is saved and does nothing, and nobody is told. Not deciding leaves row 6 of the maintainer's card open with no lane allowed to act.
- **Reader who acts after the ruling:** the domain:ui#6 seat (`os-sales`) files the cards named in 裁后执行 for the ruled letter; the building lanes are `domain:spec`, `domain:services`/`domain:server` and `domain:ui` as listed per letter.
- **Dedupe** (`gh api -X GET search/issues -f q='repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue <terms>' --jq .total_count`, 2026-11-05, any state):
  - `notification preference topic channel picker` → 15 hits; relevant: #25346 (closed, ruled A), #24775 (closed), #27855 (closed: raw topic values shown on System Overview, display only), #30208 (this card's source). None is an open decision on this question.
  - `notification preference topic channel` → 39 hits (QA runs and the same closed cards).
  - `notification topic picker` → 20 hits; no open card.
  - `suggestion options text field combobox` → 2 hits; neither is a spec-lane card on suggestion sources: ruling A item 5 says that card "is not filed by it", and it has not been filed since. **New.**
  - `route A 25346` → 4 hits (#25346 and the cards citing it).

## Related cards and PRs

- #30208 (source, open; rows 4 and 9 landed in PR #30488, +135/−36), comment 6651344343, report 6659032953, Release 6659910397.
- #25346 (closed completed): claim 6365308855, needs_decision report 6365345478, ruling 6365616409 (A), landed PR #25449 (+124/−14, 9 files, merged 2026-10-23T15:01Z).
- #24770 ruling D → #24983 → PR #25028 (+357/−251, 12 files, merged 2026-10-21): the template channel refusal; #24895 (closed): user id → `sys_user` lookup on the same object.
- ADR-0030 (L3 preference, `defineTopic()` catalog as remaining work), ADR-0118 D1 (refuse-over-store on `user_id`), ADR-0072 (pickers over a served scope replace typing names from memory).

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性:C 缩小特例(一个通用「建议来源」契约覆盖所有开放词表,字段契约不动,落的是 ADR-0030 已写的目录);A 保留缺口;B 新增随部署状态变化的拒绝;D 关闭 ADR 刻意开放的渠道接缝并引入第二种通配拼写。
② 实际业务拉动:维护者本人在 #30208 第 6 行与 6651344343 两次撞上,HotCRM QA 在 #25346 先撞上;同一对象已因同类问题把用户 id 改成选择器(#24895)。D 的封闭集合零拉动。
③ 防 AI 犯错:今天与 A 是静默容忍(填错被存下、永不生效、无人被告知);B 与 D 只在渠道一侧响亮拒绝,主题仍静默;C 在渠道给闭合枚举、在主题给建议,手填残留与今天相同,后续可加「匹配不到任何已发通知」的警告而非拒绝。
④ 创业阶段不扩散:A 零声明;B 新增一条依赖注册表的运行时规则;C 新增一个键族(建议来源),是 ADR-0030 已承诺义务的交付而非新增门禁;D 新增 select 选项值、通配拼写与一次迁移,永久背负。
Prior rulings read: notification preference topic channel picker → 15 hits; ADR-0030 (L3 preference, defineTopic() remaining), ADR-0118 D1, ADR-0072; thread: #25346 ruling 6365616409 (A), #24770 ruling D (6293376907)
